text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki met with her mother alongside 
her Trainer. There, she learned that her 
mother, a famous stage actress, also 
battles with immense pressure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her mother's words made Fuji Kiseki 
realize something vital. Even if you fail, 
continuing to challenge yourself is the 
true resolve required to stand upon the 
turf—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki renews her resolve. Her 
Trainer believed without a doubt that she 
could overcome this.
